newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks plunge at close on lack of support.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks plunge at close on lack of support.

text.p: Stocks plunged at the close on Monday as settlement day position-squaring by retail investors turned into a selling spree on a lack of support from institutions, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 24.21 points, or 1.56 percent, to close at 1,523.84. Losers led gainers 199 to 31, with PTCL falling 0.80 rupees to 27.80 rupees and Shell Pakistan 8.0 to 232.
"Absence of support despite sharp falls in blue chips prompted individuals to keep selling," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
